plan.purpose: Reduce bad-period losses and equity drawdown while retaining EUR100-200 net winning trades

hypotheses.baseline: Original M30/M1 model, 20-pip initial SL and original R trailing
hypotheses.atr_trailing: Initial stop =1.5*mean true range of last 14 CLOSED M30 bars; original 2R TP and 1R trailing. Risk-derived size, broker max volume rather than inherited lot ceiling.
hypotheses.atr_fixed2r: Same ATR-scaled initial stop; fixed 2R target, no trailing. Existing position-risk loss guard retained.
hypotheses.unrestricted_entries: Original fixed stop/trailing; remove inherited session, spread and EUR150 daily-loss entry restrictions in PAPER ONLY. Spread and all other modeled execution costs still charged. Single-position and 0.5% exposure guard retained.

plan.risk_fixed: EUR20,000 start; 0.5% risk per entry, risk-derived lots, one position and 0.5% concurrent exposure cap. Never widen an already-open stop, average down or increase size after a loss. All changes are paper-only.
plan.accounting: Each period is ONE continuous account starting EUR20,000, without monthly resets. End equity includes all modeled costs. Equity drawdown uses open P&L at observed M1 closes, incurred entry commission and actual simulated exit fills; it excludes unknown intrabar/tick extremes and swap.
plan.selection: Highest earlier base-cost net, tie lower M1-close equity drawdown. Lock before later results. No arbitrary sample gate hides a candidate; trade counts, EUR100-200 winners and drawdowns are disclosed for every model.
plan.evaluation: Show earlier net/loss and drawdown, later net/drawdown, mean winners and count EUR100-200, plus doubled-cost outcomes. No live approval; positive results must be observed, not assumed.
limitations: Earlier and later dates and baseline outcomes were previously examined; this is exploratory historical validation, not untouched forward evidence.
A larger mean winner does not guarantee every successful trade reaches EUR100-200; trade counts and target-band counts are retained.
Swap/financing excluded; commission/slippage assumptions and constant historical symbol valuation. No full tick/latency model.
Broker volume maximum is honored; historical margin requirements and broker minimum stop-distance constraints are not reconstructed.
M1-close equity drawdown can be smaller than intrabar drawdown. Daily guard is a trigger, not a guaranteed loss bound.
The unrestricted paper scenario disables the daily guard and can incur larger daily losses; it does not alter the live protection. Research hooks are not enabled in live profiles.
No tuning of the four hypotheses after outcomes. Both years were previously examined; no statistical confirmation is claimed.

plan.purpose: Add already-known spread<=0.9 benchmark and full-history continuous accounts. No tuning, no new discovery, no change to original nomination.
plan.tasks: Four known-cost separate-period base/stress replays and four full-history baseline/known-cost base/stress replays; all EUR20k, 0.5% risk, original exits/guards.
